importStudents.title: Import students
importStudents.how: Choose an Excel file (.xlsx) or a CSV file. The first sheet is read, and its first row must hold the column headings. Each row needs a name and a date of birth. Roll numbers are given by the app, as for a registration. Students under 18 are not imported: register them with the form, so the parent's consent is recorded. You see every row's problems before anything is saved, and only the good rows are imported.
importStudents.columnsHint: Guessed from the headings. Change a match if it is wrong. * = needed.

fields.rollNo: Old roll number (only to find repeats)

importStudents.fixHint: Rows with problems are left out. Fix them in the file and import it again: rows already imported are found as repeats.
importStudents.askBody: Each gets a roll number. Rows the database refuses are listed afterwards; the others are saved.
